bullets.title: NVDA CDS Spreads Hit Historic Wides; Tech Credit Stress Broadens
bullets.body: Torsten Slok data flagged on FinTwit shows CDS spreads widening across tech broadly, with Oracle and Coreweave described as 'in a separate (worse) league' with particularly alarming credit deterioration. Separately, the cost of protecting NVDA debt against default surged to the largest single-day widening in history per one account.

bullets.title: SK Hynix Miss Triggers KOSPI Circuit Breakers; MU Read-Through Mixed
bullets.body: South Korean stocks fell 6% with the KOSPI now down ~38-39% from its all-time high, triggering back-to-back circuit breakers for the first time in KOSPI history. SK Hynix posted a record Q2 beat on underlying earnings yet shares fell ~14%, with one account noting a full Micron read-across analysis 'in both directions.' A 3x leveraged SK Hynix ETP traded in Ireland collapsed 96% since mid-June.

bullets.title: SOXL -15% on Heavy Volume; Goldman Momentum Basket Worst Month in History
bullets.body: Semiconductor leveraged ETF SOXL crashed another 15% on volume exceeding 125 million shares. Goldman's high-beta momentum basket is on track for its worst monthly performance on record, with one macro account warning that recent market rotation is 'short-covering flows, not fundamental revaluation' away from the AI/semi theme.

bullets.title: VRT Down 13% Premarket on Earnings
bullets.body: Vertiv ($VRT) declined 13% in premarket trading following its earnings release, per multiple accounts flagging the move.

bullets.title: Big Tech Capex Scrutiny Elevated Ahead of Earnings; Monetization the Key Metric
bullets.body: One fintwit account focused on the AI Revolution theme notes enterprises are 'lining up for AI strategic buildouts' and that Big Tech capex plans are expected to accelerate, but stresses that 'monetization signs will be key to maintaining investor patience' as the sector enters a critical reporting window.

bullets.title: Zuckerberg Pushes US to Accelerate AI; Opposes Blocking Chinese Models
bullets.body: Meta CEO Zuckerberg publicly urged the US not to block Chinese AI models as a strategy to maintain competitive edge in the AI arms race, arguing technology benefits outweigh risks and opposing regulations that could slow open-source AI innovation. NVDA's CEO separately defended open-weight AI models on the same day.

bullets.title: MSFT Short Interest Hits Highest Since May 2015; UK CMA Probe Adds Pressure
bullets.body: Microsoft short interest reached its highest level since May 2015, flagged as a notable bearish positioning signal. Separately, the UK Competition and Markets Authority opened a probe into Microsoft's marketing of subscription plans.

bullets.title: STX Among 20 Earnings Triple Plays Since Yesterday's Close
bullets.body: A total of 20 companies have posted earnings triple plays (beat EPS, beat sales, raised guidance) since yesterday's close, with Seagate ($STX) cited as one example.

bullets.title: Bernstein Raises US eCommerce Forecasts; AMZN Focus Shifts to AWS
bullets.body: Bernstein raised its US eCommerce growth forecast to 11% for Q2, up from 5-6% in recent quarters, with strong results expected from Etsy and Wayfair. For Amazon specifically, the firm notes earnings are 'dependent more on AWS than eCommerce.'

bullets.title: Oil Surges 5% on Middle East Escalation; Jazan Refinery Offline
bullets.body: WTI crude hit $83.34, up ~5%, and Brent futures rose to $88.13/bbl as US-Iran tensions escalated with strikes reported in northwest Iran and joint US-Saudi strikes on Iran-backed sites in Iraq. Saudi Aramco's 400k b/d Jazan refinery was shut down July 27 following a Houthi attack; Ukraine separately struck a Rosneft refinery overnight.

bullets.title: Fed Day: Rate Hike Odds at 31%; MOVE Index Signals Hawkish Volatility
bullets.body: Markets assign only 31% probability to a Fed hike today. However, the MOVE bond volatility index has shifted to a bullish trend (unfavorable for bonds), and one account notes the 'TREND signal still says hawkish' despite front-runner positioning for dovish messaging from Warsh.

bullets.title: South Korea Considers Restricting Leveraged ETFs to Professionals After Retail Blow-Up
bullets.body: South Korea's Financial Services Commission is weighing restrictions on single-stock leveraged ETFs to professional investors only after a 3x leveraged ETF collapsed 80% in under two months—with retail investors reportedly using mortgage loans as collateral. South Korea's finance minister apologized for the 'reckless launch' of the product.

bullets.title: Retail Investor Portfolios Down 20% YTD vs SPY +8.5%; Breadth Concentrated Outside Retail Favorites
bullets.body: One macro account notes retail (CNBC-type) investor portfolios are down roughly 20% YTD and 16% in the past month while SPY is up 8.5%. Separately, 71% of stocks rose an average +2.6% the prior session, but 'the stocks going up are not the ones retail investors own.'

bullets.title: NextEra + Brookfield Team on $100B Kentucky Data Campus
bullets.body: NextEra Energy and Brookfield are partnering on a data center project exceeding $100 billion at a decommissioned Cold War uranium-enrichment facility in Kentucky, which will include a data center campus and generating plant.

bullets.title: GLW, CHTR Price Targets Cut by Multiple Banks
bullets.body: JP Morgan cut Charter Communications to $150 from $200. Corning ($GLW) received cuts from both Citigroup (to $220 from $240) and JP Morgan (to $170 from $200), with Barclays also cutting to $129.

bullets.title: ACN Up 25% Since Analyst Call; Analyst Access Timing Highlighted
bullets.body: Accenture has gained 25% since analyst Frank's recommendation was flagged, with one account noting the move as evidence that 'timing of access to research matters for investment performance.'

bullets.title: Advantest Raises FY2027 Operating Income Guidance Well Above Consensus
bullets.body: Advantest boosted its full-year operating income guidance to 846 billion yen from prior guidance of 627.5 billion yen, meaningfully above Bloomberg consensus of 708.51 billion yen—a positive read for the semiconductor test equipment supply chain.

bullets.title: NVDA Cosmos Models Hit 10M Downloads on HuggingFace
bullets.body: NVIDIA's Cosmos models reached 10 million downloads on HuggingFace, cited as a signal of strong developer and research community adoption of NVDA's physical AI foundation models.
